headline: A full-service laundromat in Taft.
intro: Self-service washers and dryers, or drop it off and we will wash, dry and fold it for you.
about: Hometown Soap N Sudz is a veteran owned and operated, fully attended laundromat at 355 Davis Rd in Taft, Texas. The laundromat runs Wascomat equipment throughout, and you can either use the machines yourself or leave your laundry with us for same-day wash, dry and fold. Pricing is posted with no hidden fees, and there is free WiFi, free popcorn, snack and drink machines, and a self-serve change machine on site.
menuNote: Open daily 9:00 am to 10:00 pm. The last wash goes in at 9:00 pm.
